name: Historic Center Tour
description: A gentle introduction to Ambato's colonial architecture and safe urban cycling paths.

name: Ambato River Route
description: A scenic ride along the river valley with some challenging climbs to test your stamina.

name: Andes High Trail
description: A rugged excursion through the high Andean foothills with technical terrain and high altitude.

name: Sunday Sun Glide
description: A relaxed morning ride to enjoy the local markets and quiet city streets.

name: Ambato Express
description: A fast-paced tour of Ambato's commercial heart and hidden architectural gems.

name: Protector Forest Loop
description: Immersive nature ride through the native forests and eucalyptus groves of Tungurahua.

name: Family Stroll
description: A flat, safe ride designed for families and new cyclists to enjoy the city.

name: Volcano Challenge
description: The ultimate climb to the high peaks surrounding the city. Not for the faint of heart.

name: Lagoon Circular
description: A peaceful loop around the local lagoons with plenty of scenic views of the valley.

name: Ambato Lights Ride
description: Experience the city lights at night. High-visibility gear and helmets required.

name: Heritage Path
description: A historical tour visiting Ambato's most important cultural landmarks.

name: Devil's Canyon
description: Technical descent and steep climbs through the dramatic canyon landscape.

name: University Route
description: A short ride demonstrating the safest routes for students and faculty.

name: Ambato Bridges
description: Crossing the city's major bridges for a panoramic view of the urban skyline.

name: Flower Trail
description: A seasonal ride through the flower-growing regions on the outskirts of Ambato.
